mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorites WHERE favorite_id = #{favoriteId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.favorite_id, f.user_id, f.accommodation_id, f.created_at, a.title as accommodation_title, a.address as accommodation_address, (SELECT i.image_url FROM images i WHERE i.reference_id = a.accommodation_id AND i.reference_type = 'ACCOMMODATION' AND i.is_main = true LIMIT 1) as main_image_url FROM favorites f JOIN accommodations a ON f.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
